issue_summary.TRUTH_CHECK: The text explicitly mentions measuring samples in triplicate. However, in proteomics, "measured in triplicate" typically refers to biological replicates unless specified as technical replicates (repeated injections of the same processed sample). In this experimental design, the "five spike-in states" are the biological samples, and measuring each in triplicate is the standard way to report biological replicates. There is no mention of additional technical replicates (e.g., multiple injections per biological replicate).
issue_summary.COMPLETENESS_CHECK: The full set contains only this value, but the value itself is likely a misidentification of biological replicates as technical replicates.
